Name: Harvey Sells Potions (SVE)
Author: Crezia
Description:
I  was playing my witchy save while using the wonderful  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19315]Cuter Potions[/url]﻿ and noticed that some of the items that could be bought in the clinic didn't match the aesthetic I was looking for, so I decided to do something about it! [s]*cough* Or so I tried *cough*

[/s]This mod:

1. Re-names the four items sold at the Clinic: Muscle Remedy and Energy Tonic (Vanilla), & Sports Drink and Stamina Capsule (SVE).
2. Changes the description of the four items.
3. Changes the appearance of the [u]Sports Drink[/u] and [u]Stamina Capsule[/u] [b][u]only[/u][/b]. For the other ones, I recommend the Cuter Potions mod mentioned at the beginning.

I'm planning on doing the other elixirs from SVE in the future, if everything goes well! This was my first mode and I barely manage to make it run, so if you have any suggestions on it and on how to improve it, I would be very happy to hear them!

Manifest.Name: (CP) Harvey Sells Potions
Manifest.Description: Replaces the name and look of the Sport Drink and Stamina Capsule items of SVE for potions and changes the name and description of Vanilla Tonic and Remedy.
Manifest.Author: Crezia
